recovery_protocol: Record actual native session IDs after launch.
Require actual-model Hermes startup plus a concrete output/task before calling a new session working.
Store task/source/output hashes and real next action in each owner checkpoint.
On crash resume the recorded session and verify recent files/manifest hashes; never mutate failed evidence.
A mail watcher does not prove model activity or guarantee resumption while the computer/app is off.

monitoring_handoff.responsibility: Main model accepts reading worker inboxes/checkpoints and rearming or replacing the bounded monitor before its end. Actual model turns required; watcher does not prove model operation.
